# Palantir

> Documentation for Palantir's enterprise platforms: Foundry (data integration and analytics), AIP (AI Platform for generative AI), Gotham (defense and intelligence), and Apollo (deployment infrastructure).

Palantir provides comprehensive technical documentation covering the Ontology system, Automate workflow engine, AIP Agent Studio, data connectors, and platform architecture. The documentation serves developers, architects, and administrators building AI-powered applications and data pipelines on Palantir's platforms.

## Key Topics

- Foundry - Data integration and application platform
- AIP (AI Platform) - Generative AI and large language model integration
- Ontology - Core semantic data model and object system
- Apollo - Continuous deployment and infrastructure management
- Gotham - Defense and intelligence platform
- Automate - Workflow automation and event-driven actions
- AIP Agent Studio - AI agent development and deployment
- Multimodal Data Plane (MMDP) - Open data and compute architecture
- Action Types - Ontology operations and side effects
- Code Workspaces - Development environments (JupyterLab, RStudio)
- Data Connectors - Integration with external systems (Databricks, Kinesis, REST APIs)
- Rubix - Kubernetes substrate for platform operations
- AIP Assist - Context-aware AI assistance
- Model Studio - Machine learning model development
- Flow Capture - Process mining and workflow analysis

## Platform Architecture & Core Concepts

- [Documentation Hub](https://www.palantir.com/docs): Central documentation hub for Foundry, Apollo, Gotham, and AIP platforms
- [Architecture Center Overview](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/architecture-center): Foundry architecture center covering platform design and capabilities
- [AIP, Foundry, and Apollo Platforms](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/architecture-center/platforms): Overview of AIP, Foundry, and Apollo platform integration
- [The Ontology System](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/architecture-center/ontology-system): Core Ontology system for representing complex interconnected decisions
- [Multimodal Data Plane](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/architecture-center/multimodal-data-plane): Palantir's Multimodal Data Plane (MMDP) open data and compute architecture
- [AIP Architecture Overview](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/architecture-center/aip-architecture): AIP platform architecture for connecting generative AI to operations
- [The Rubix Substrate](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/architecture-center/rubix): Rubix Kubernetes substrate powering AIP, Foundry, and Apollo
- [Interoperability](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/architecture-center/interoperability): AIP and Foundry interoperability with data, AI, and security systems

## Data Connectors Reference

- [Databricks Connector](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/available-connectors/databricks): Databricks connector for data, compute, and model integration
- [REST APIs Connector](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/available-connectors/rest-apis): REST API integration guide for external system connectivity
- [Amazon Kinesis Connector](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/available-connectors/amazon-kinesis): Connect Foundry to Amazon Kinesis for realtime stream data ingestion
- [Splunk Connector](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/available-connectors/splunk): Splunk connector for log and event data integration
- [Presto Connector](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/available-connectors/presto): Presto connector for distributed SQL query engine integration
- [CockroachDB Connector](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/available-connectors/cockroachdb): CockroachDB connector documentation for database integration
- [Google Campaign Manager Connector](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/available-connectors/google-campaign-manager): Google Campaign Manager connector for marketing data integration
- [LinkedIn Connector](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/available-connectors/linkedin): LinkedIn connector documentation for social data integration
- [Tableau CRM Analytics Connector](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/available-connectors/tableau-crm-analytics): Tableau CRM Analytics connector for analytics data integration
- [QuickBooks POS Connector](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/available-connectors/quickbooks-pos): QuickBooks POS connector for point-of-sale data integration
- [Act! CRM Connector](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/available-connectors/act!-crm): Act! CRM connector documentation and configuration reference
